title: Gazette notification regarding reconstitution of DCPPAI

247001 सदस्ट्य सजर्व 2. जवकास पररषद (प्रदियात् मक ) जनयमावली, 1952 के जनयम 2 के खंड (ग) के अनुसरण में केन्‍दर सरकार उक्त जवकास पररषद् के सदस्ट्य सजर्व का कायध करने के जलए जनदेिक/ प्र भारी जनदेिक, केन्‍दरीय लुगदी और कागि अनुसंधान संस्ट्थान , सहारनपुर (उत्तर प्र देि ) को जनयुक्त करती है। [फा. सं. 8(5)/2019- कागि] अजनल अग्रवाल , संयुि सजर्व MINISTRY OF COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY (Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade) ORDER New Delhi, the 6th March, 2020 S.O. 1023(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by section 6 of the Industries (Development and Regulation) Act, 1951 (65 of 1951), read with rules 2, 3, 4 and 5 of the Development Council (Procedural) Rules, 1952, the Central Government hereby establishes a Development Council for Pulp, Paper and Allied Industries and appoints the following persons to be the members of the said Council, for a period of two years from the date of publication of this Order in the Official Gazette, namely:- Sl.
